tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: the paper layer everything sits on. Behind all data blocks and under the glass.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Table heads, inactive tabs, the base KPI tile. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: paper-column
tokens.usage: Highlighted columns (Ist, Forecast) and row hover. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Square controls on paper, e.g. the search button in a table head.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every paper border: tabs, KPI strip, table frame, header-row rule. Structural hairline (about 1.5:1 on `paper` in both themes), so never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of a quiet square action on paper, e.g. the arrow box of a project tile (decorative: the whole tile is the link). Also the hover fill of `button-neutral` in light.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside tables and unlit dots in the dot matrix.

tokens.name: line-over-signal
tokens.usage: The KPI strip's outline where it is drawn over the `signal` band: reads as `line` on `paper`, blends into blue.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, numbers, the totals rule. On every paper and glass ground. As a fill (light block in dark) it is reserved for high emphasis: the user's own chat bubble.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, column heads, breadcrumbs, inactive nav. Light: 6.1:1 on `paper`, 5.5:1 on `paper-sunken`. Dark: 7.1:1 and 6.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and empty-cell dashes on `paper` (light 4.9:1, dark 5.4:1).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill, e.g. the user's chat bubble.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted text on an `ink` fill (light 7.3:1, dark 5.7:1).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Fill of the current selection on paper: the active tab. Light: the `ink` block. Dark: a dark grey block, because a white block is reserved for high emphasis.

tokens.name: on-selection
tokens.usage: Label on a `selection` fill (light 17:1, dark 9.7:1).

tokens.name: on-selection-muted
tokens.usage: Counters on a `selection` fill, e.g. the item count in the active tab (light 7.3:1, dark 5.5:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: AI and signals only: the forecast-with-signals KPI band, dot-matrix lit dots, the assistant dot, the send button, the title's full stop. As dots on `paper` it is 2.6:1 in light (7.1:1 in dark): the values always also exist as numbers and in the cell's aria-label.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a `signal` fill (light 6.0:1, dark 6.8:1).

tokens.name: on-signal-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a `signal` fill: time, note and unit on the highlighted project tile. As drawn in the source design it is 3.7:1 (light) and 4.0:1 (dark), below 4.5:1: keep it to meta that is repeated elsewhere, never the only place a fact appears.

tokens.name: on-signal-negative
tokens.usage: Negative dots of a project mark drawn on a `signal` fill (the highlighted project tile); 3.5:1 light, 3.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-signal-off
tokens.usage: Unlit dots of a project mark drawn on a `signal` fill.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The blurred radial glow behind the assistant panel. One glow per screen.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links on paper, e.g. the topics count in a table row (light 4.8:1, dark 8.6:1).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Background of the selected table row. Text: `ink`.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive deltas in numbers (light 5.7:1, dark 8.3:1). Always with a + sign.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative deltas in numbers (light 5.4:1, dark 7.1:1). Always with a − sign.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Border and icon of anything that needs a clarifying question (Rückfrage). Light 4.1:1, dark 7.3:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: review-ink
tokens.usage: Text of review tags and the review button (light 5.7:1, dark 8.2:1 on `review-fill`).

tokens.name: review-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the review button.

tokens.name: button-neutral
tokens.usage: Fill of the sign-in button: a quiet grey (light #c9c7c1, dark #3a3936) instead of white or black, which stay reserved for high emphasis. Text `ink` (light 10.7:1, dark 9.7:1).

tokens.name: button-neutral-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of `button-neutral`.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of every glass surface: the top bar and the assistant panel. Always with the `glass-blur` effect.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: Outline of glass surfaces and of controls inside them.

tokens.name: glass-divider
tokens.usage: Dividers on glass: between the logo/nav and the breadcrumbs in the top bar, under the assistant header when it is open.

tokens.name: glass-control
tokens.usage: Quiet controls on glass: list items, suggestion chips, the Chat toggle.

tokens.name: glass-control-strong
tokens.usage: The current nav item in the top bar.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of quiet controls on glass: icon buttons, the assistant bar, chips, glass buttons.

tokens.name: glass-field
tokens.usage: The chat composer field.

tokens.name: glass-airy
tokens.usage: Fill of the airy glass style: a second glass look for the top bar and the assistant, brighter behind and more translucent so the signal band and glow shine through. Always with `glass-airy-blur`. Dark: identical to `glass`.

tokens.name: glass-airy-control
tokens.usage: List items and suggestion chips inside airy glass: solid white in light, no border, no shadow. Dark: as `glass-control`, without border.

tokens.name: glass-airy-field
tokens.usage: The chat composer inside airy glass: solid white in light, no border, no shadow. Dark: as `glass-field`, without border.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Fill of the sign-in card, the one glass surface that sits in the middle of the screen. Always with `glass-card-blur` and `shadow-card`.

tokens.name: glass-card-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the sign-in card.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Wash over the blurred, zoomed-out app behind the sign-in card. Fades out on sign-in.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title, two short lines, full stop in `signal`.

styles.name: sign-in-title
styles.usage: The sign-in card's title, full stop in `signal`.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Table and section titles on paper.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: Values in the KPI strip, tabular numbers.

styles.name: search-input
styles.usage: The search field in a table head.

styles.name: tile-value
styles.usage: The figure on a project tile, tabular numbers; unit in `label`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Am stärksten wirkt Nachfrage auf die Umsatzerlöse.
styles.usage: Table cells, nav, buttons, assistant messages.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Eine Position öffnen, um Verlauf, Quellen und Themen zu sehen.
styles.usage: Descriptions under titles, KPI labels, chips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Meta lines, column heads, status, counters, units.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above the page title.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Sub-labels in column heads, sources under assistant answers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between nav items and icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding, glass control padding, title-block gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Glass inset from the screen edge and between glass surfaces; KPI tile padding.

tokens.name: space-indent
tokens.usage: Indent of the paper content from the glass bar's left edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside the glass bar and table heads.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked paper blocks (title block, tabs, KPI strip, table).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between the glass bar and the page title.

tokens.name: radius-paper
tokens.usage: Everything on paper: tabs, tiles, tables, buttons, tags. Paper is always square.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls inside glass: nav items, chips, list items, buttons, composer.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles; the user's bubble has a 4px corner toward its sender.

tokens.name: radius-glass
tokens.usage: Glass surfaces: the top bar and the assistant panel.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The sign-in card.

tokens.name: radius-card-control
tokens.usage: The button inside the sign-in card (its arrow chip uses 11px).

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every floating glass surface. Paper never casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The sign-in card only: a deep drop and a 1px top highlight. The one place glass has a highlight.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of every glass surface. Matte: no gloss or inner highlight.

tokens.name: glass-airy-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of airy glass in light: brightens and saturates what is behind so blue reads clean, not muddy. In dark, airy glass uses `glass-blur`.

tokens.name: glass-card-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the sign-in card.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav items, icon buttons.

tokens.name: tab-height
tokens.usage: Report tabs.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows (totals 56px).

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: The glass top bar.

tokens.name: assistant-width
tokens.usage: The assistant panel.

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: The search row that heads a table (search in the table head).
